evals.prompt: Show me the picture of impediments for the daily.
evals.expected_output: Unknown-aging bucket at the top, separated from those within the limit.
expectations: Impediments without a reliable date appear in their own unknown-aging bucket
That bucket appears before or alongside the escalation bucket, not at the end
No impediment of unknown age is reported as being within the limit
The impediment with 11 business days appears as to escalate

evals.prompt: Team impediments. We're in the week of 25 April, with a bridge day on Monday.
evals.expected_output: Aging that discounts holidays and does not trigger undue escalation.
expectations: The holidays passed in the input are discounted from the business-day count
The holidays applied are echoed in the output
No impediment is escalated merely because of the holiday days

evals.prompt: Our team doesn't use the Flagged field, we mark blockers with the Blocked status.
evals.expected_output: Alternative mapping recognised, without silently returning zero impediments.
expectations: The proposed JQL covers the Blocked status and not only the Flagged field
If it finds no impediments, it says so explicitly instead of presenting an empty list as good news
The marking mechanism used is recorded in the notes

evals.prompt: Is there any blocker that nobody is following?
evals.expected_output: Focus on those without an owner and those of unknown aging.
expectations: Identifies the impediment without an owner
Identifies those of unknown aging as a risk of slipping through in silence
Does not resolve or reassign anything (read-only)

evals.prompt: Impediments for the NAC board for the daily.
evals.expected_output: Warning that zero impediments may be a JQL that does not cover the team's marking mechanism.
expectations: The report does NOT present zero impediments as good news
Warns that the marking mechanism (Flagged field, Blocked status or label) must be confirmed
The warning appears in the delivered report, not only in the script output
